const _EK = 'Jmy1IDteoo6UdkMuS5M8hdX5rUENAA/F';

const _EI = 200000;

let _dataReady = false;
function _b64ToBytes(b64){
  const binStr = atob(b64);
  const len = binStr.length;
  const bytes = new Uint8Array(len);
  for(let i=0;i<len;i++) bytes[i] = binStr.charCodeAt(i);
  return bytes;
}
function _hexToBytes(hex){
  const bytes = new Uint8Array(hex.length/2);
  for(let i=0;i<bytes.length;i++) bytes[i] = parseInt(hex.substr(i*2,2),16);
  return bytes;
}
async function _decryptAppData(){
  try{
    const enc = new TextEncoder();
    const keyMaterial = await crypto.subtle.importKey('raw', enc.encode(_EK), {name:'PBKDF2'}, false, ['deriveKey']);
    const salt = _hexToBytes(_ES);
    const aesKey = await crypto.subtle.deriveKey(
      {name:'PBKDF2', salt, iterations:_EI, hash:'SHA-256'},
      keyMaterial,
      {name:'AES-GCM', length:256},
      false,
      ['decrypt']
    );
    const raw = _b64ToBytes(_EP);
    const iv = raw.slice(0,12);
    const ciphertext = raw.slice(12);
    const decryptedBuf = await crypto.subtle.decrypt({name:'AES-GCM', iv}, aesKey, ciphertext);
    let decryptedText = new TextDecoder().decode(decryptedBuf);
    decryptedText = decryptedText.replace(/@@IMG(\d+)@@/g, (m, i) => _EIMGS[Number(i)]);
    (0, eval)(decryptedText);
    _dataReady = true;
    const btn = document.getElementById('login-btn');
    const status = document.getElementById('data-load-status');
    if(btn) btn.disabled = false;
    if(status) status.style.display = 'none';
  }catch(e){
    console.error('data decrypt failed', e);
    const status = document.getElementById('data-load-status');
    if(status){ status.textContent = 'App ဒေတာ Load မရပါ — Browser အသစ်ဖြင့် ထပ်ကြိုးစားကြည့်ပါ။'; status.style.color = 'var(--red)'; }
  }
}

function escapeHtml(str){
  return (str||'').toString().replace(/[&<>"']/g, s=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[s]));
}
// Converts unicode superscript/subscript characters (and _{word} / ^(...) notation) into real
// <sup>/<sub> HTML tags, so exponents and subscripts render correctly on every device/font
// instead of relying on rare unicode glyphs (⁻²₀ᵢ etc.) that many fonts don't include.
// Applies the inline math notation (superscript/subscript/fraction/complement-bar)
// to a string that has ALREADY been HTML-escaped. Shared by formatMath's plain-text
// path and by the [TABLE]...[/TABLE] cell renderer, so the same {{a|b}}, [[x]],
// _{...}, ^(...) notation works identically inside table cells.
function formatInline(s){
  const supMap = {'⁰':'0','¹':'1','²':'2','³':'3','⁴':'4','⁵':'5','⁶':'6','⁷':'7','⁸':'8','⁹':'9','⁻':'-','⁺':'+'};
  const subMap = {'₀':'0','₁':'1','₂':'2','₃':'3','₄':'4','₅':'5','₆':'6','₇':'7','₈':'8','₉':'9','ᵢ':'i','ₒ':'o','ᵣ':'r'};
  s = s.replace(/[⁰¹²³⁴⁵⁶⁷⁸⁹⁻⁺]/g, c => `<sup>${supMap[c]}</sup>`);
  s = s.replace(/[₀₁₂₃₄₅₆₇₈₉ᵢₒᵣ]/g, c => `<sub>${subMap[c]}</sub>`);
  s = s.replace(/_\{([A-Za-z0-9\/]+)\}/g, '<sub>$1</sub>');
  s = s.replace(/\^\(([^)]+)\)/g, '<sup>$1</sup>');
  s = s.replace(/\^([A-Za-z0-9]+)/g, '<sup>$1</sup>');
  s = s.replace(/\{\{([^|{}]+)\|([^|{}]+)\}\}/g, '<span class="frac"><span class="num">$1</span><span class="den">$2</span></span>');
  s = s.replace(/\[\[([^\[\]]+)\]\]/g, '<span class="cbar">$1</span>');
  return s;
}
// Renders a [TABLE]header1|header2|...\nrow1a|row1b|...\n...[/TABLE] block (pipe-separated,
// first row = header) into a real HTML <table>. Used for truth tables etc. in problem solutions,
// since raw <table> tags typed directly into a problem's text would otherwise be HTML-escaped.
function renderSolTable(body){
  const rows = body.trim().split('\n').map(r => r.trim()).filter(r => r.length)
    .map(r => r.split('|').map(c => c.trim()));
  let html = '<div class="sol-table-wrap"><table class="sol-table"><tbody>';
  rows.forEach((row, ri) => {
    const tag = ri === 0 ? 'th' : 'td';
    html += '<tr>' + row.map(cell => `<${tag}>${formatInline(escapeHtml(cell))}</${tag}>`).join('') + '</tr>';
  });
  html += '</tbody></table></div>';
  return html;
}
// Section (B) solutions use explicit @@SHORT@@ / @@DIAGRAM@@ / @@CALC@@ markers so the
// conceptual answer, diagram description and numeric calculation each render as their own
// clearly labeled sub-block instead of one dense wall of text. See renderSplitSolution().
function renderSplitSolution(sol){
  sol = sol || '';
  const MARKERS = [
    {tag:'@@SHORT@@', cls:'sol-part-concept', label:'💬 Short Answer'},
    {tag:'@@DIAGRAM@@', cls:'sol-part-diagram', label:'🖼️ Diagram'},
    {tag:'@@CALC@@', cls:'sol-part-calc', label:'🧮 Calculation'}
  ];
  if(sol.indexOf('@@SHORT@@') !== -1 || sol.indexOf('@@DIAGRAM@@') !== -1 || sol.indexOf('@@CALC@@') !== -1){
    // Split on lines that are exactly one of the marker tokens.
    const re = /^(@@SHORT@@|@@DIAGRAM@@|@@CALC@@)\s*$/gm;
    let match, parts = [], lastIdx = 0, lastTag = null;
    while((match = re.exec(sol))){
      if(lastTag){ parts.push({tag:lastTag, content: sol.slice(lastIdx, match.index)}); }
      lastTag = match[1];
      lastIdx = match.index + match[0].length;
    }
    if(lastTag){ parts.push({tag:lastTag, content: sol.slice(lastIdx)}); }
    return parts.map(p=>{
      const m = MARKERS.find(m=>m.tag===p.tag);
      if(!m) return '';
      const content = p.content.replace(/^\n+/, '').replace(/\n+$/, '');
      return `<div class="sol-part ${m.cls}"><div class="sol-part-label">${m.label}</div>${formatMath(content)}</div>`;
    }).join('');
  }
  // Backward-compat fallback: split on first blank line into short-answer/calc.
  const idx = sol.indexOf('\n\n');
  if(idx === -1) return formatMath(sol);
  const concept = sol.slice(0, idx);
  const calc = sol.slice(idx + 2);
  return `<div class="sol-part sol-part-concept"><div class="sol-part-label">💬 Short Answer</div>${formatMath(concept)}</div>`
       + `<div class="sol-part sol-part-calc"><div class="sol-part-label">🧮 Calculation</div>${formatMath(calc)}</div>`;
}
function breakMultiQuestions(str){
  // Insert a line break after a sentence-ending "?" or "." when it's followed
  // by a new sentence, so two questions/answers bundled in one q/sol block
  // each get their own line instead of running together.
  str = str || '';
  // Protect [TABLE]...[/TABLE] blocks from these regexes: their own \n/|
  // syntax defines rows/columns for renderSolTable, and running the sentence-
  // break substitution over that text would insert spurious line breaks
  // inside table cells and corrupt the row structure.
  const tableBlocks = [];
  str = str.replace(/\[TABLE\][\s\S]*?\[\/TABLE\]/g, (m) => {
    tableBlocks.push(m);
    return `@@BMQTBL${tableBlocks.length - 1}@@`;
  });
  // Bulleted lines (each already its own line, starting with "•") are a deliberate
  // list — a bullet is often a single multi-sentence paragraph, and re-splitting it
  // on every ". [A-Z]" would shatter it into separate unbulleted lines. So the
  // sentence/sub-part break regexes below are only applied within non-bullet lines.
  str = str.split('\n').map(line => {
    if(/^\s*•/.test(line)) return line;
    line = line.replace(/([.?])\s+(?=[A-Z(])/g, '$1\n');
    // Also break before (ii), (iii), (iv), (v)... sub-part markers so a bundled
    // "Find (i) ... (ii) ... (iii) ..." question shows each sub-part on its own
    // line. The first (i) is left inline with its introducing verb.
    line = line.replace(/\s+(?=\((?:ii|iii|iv|v|vi)\)\s)/g, '\n');
    return line;
  }).join('\n');
  str = str.replace(/@@BMQTBL(\d+)@@/g, (m, idx) => tableBlocks[Number(idx)]);
  return str;
}
function formatMath(str){
  str = str || '';
  const tableBlocks = [];
  // Pull out table blocks BEFORE escaping, so their pipe/newline syntax never collides
  // with escaping or the sup/sub/frac/cbar regexes; each is replaced by a plain-ASCII
  // placeholder token that survives both, then swapped back in at the very end.
  str = str.replace(/\[TABLE\]([\s\S]*?)\[\/TABLE\]/g, (m, body) => {
    tableBlocks.push(renderSolTable(body));
    return `@@TBL${tableBlocks.length - 1}@@`;
  });

  // Split into lines and align the "=" sign across consecutive equation-style lines
  // (like a worked solution written on a blackboard), instead of leaving each line's
  // "=" wherever its own text length happens to put it. Only applies to genuinely
  // multi-line text (worked solutions) — a single-line string (a formula, an MCQ
  // option, an inline answer) is rendered exactly as before, inline, with no block
  // wrapper, since it may sit inside an inline element such as a label or a span tag.
  if(str.indexOf('\n') === -1){
    return formatInline(escapeHtml(str)).replace(/@@TBL(\d+)@@/g, (m, idx) => tableBlocks[Number(idx)]);
  }
  const lines = str.split('\n');
  let out = '';
  let group = []; // buffered consecutive eq-line HTML strings
  const flushGroup = ()=>{
    if(group.length){
      out += `<div class="eq-group">${group.join('')}</div>`;
      group = [];
    }
  };
  lines.forEach(line=>{
    const trimmed = line.trim();
    if(/^@@TBL\d+@@$/.test(trimmed)){
      flushGroup();
      out += trimmed; // swapped back to real table HTML below
      return;
    }
    const eqIdx = line.indexOf('=');
    const isTablePlaceholder = trimmed.indexOf('@@TBL') !== -1;
    // A genuine equation chain ("θ = a = b = c") has short math terms between each
    // "=". A prose sentence that merely happens to contain two unrelated bare
    // "=" signs (e.g. "capacitor of capacitance C = 35 μF ... resistance R = 120 Ω")
    // has long, multi-word segments instead — those must NOT be treated as a chain,
    // or each "=" gets stretched onto its own spaced-out row.
    // Count only genuine "prose words" on each side of an "=" — standalone math
    // operator/symbol tokens (×, ÷, +, -, parentheses-only fragments, etc.) don't
    // count as words, so a numeric substitution line full of "×" between short
    // terms (e.g. "½ × 1.2 × (70² - 60²)") isn't mistaken for a prose sentence
    // just because it has many space-separated tokens.
    const isOperatorToken = t => /^[×÷+\-()±]+$/.test(t);
    const eqPartsWordCounts = eqIdx > -1 ? line.split('=').map(p => p.trim().split(/\s+/).filter(t => t && !isOperatorToken(t)).length) : [];
    const hasLongProsePart = eqPartsWordCounts.some(n => n > 5);
    const qualifies = eqIdx > -1 && !isTablePlaceholder && !hasLongProsePart && line.indexOf(',') === -1 && !/since/i.test(line) && line.indexOf('?') === -1;
    if(qualifies){
      // A chained equation ("θ = a = b = c") gets one row per "=", each new
      // "=" starting its own line underneath — like a worked derivation — instead
      // of running the whole chain across one long line.
      const parts = line.split('=').map(p => p.trim());
      for(let i = 1; i < parts.length; i++){
        const leftHtml = i === 1 ? formatInline(escapeHtml(parts[0])) : '';
        const rightHtml = formatInline(escapeHtml(parts[i]));
        group.push(`<span class="eq-line"><span class="eq-lhs">${leftHtml}</span><span class="eq-eq">=</span><span class="eq-rhs">${rightHtml}</span></span>`);
      }
    } else {
      flushGroup();
      out += `<div class="eq-plain">${formatInline(escapeHtml(line))}</div>`;
    }
  });
  flushGroup();
  out = out.replace(/@@TBL(\d+)@@/g, (m, idx) => tableBlocks[Number(idx)]);
  return out;
}
function normalizeFib(str){ return str.trim().toLowerCase(); }
// ---------- multi-part short-question colour coding ----------
// When a short question bundles several sub-questions together (e.g. "...decrease?
// Explain. What is the equivalent unit of farad?"), colour each sub-question's
// question text and its matching answer block with the same background tint, so a
// 2-question item shows 2 colours and a 3-question item shows 3 colours, making it
// easy to see which part of the answer belongs to which part of the question.
const MQ_COLORS = ['#e0f2fe','#fef3c7','#dcfce7','#fce7f3','#ede9fe','#ffedd5'];
// Cross-check against the Short Q&A bank tab: a short exam item's "source" tag
// (e.g. "Short Q&A — Chapter 9 — ..., Q.17 & Q.18") names exactly which bank
// item(s) were bundled together, and each bank item's own "q"/"a" fields are the
// real, correctly-scoped question/answer text for just that one sub-question.
function subQuestionItems(part){
  const src = part && part.source || '';
  const chMatch = src.match(/Chapter\s+(\d+)/);
  const qNums = (src.match(/Q\.(\d+)/g) || []).map(s => parseInt(s.slice(2), 10));
  if(chMatch && qNums.length >= 2){
    const chData = SHORTQ[parseInt(chMatch[1], 10)];
    if(chData && chData.items){
      const items = qNums.map(n => chData.items[n - 1]);
      if(!items.some(it => !it || !it.a)) return items;
    }
  }
  // Fallback for a single bank item (or no bank tag at all) whose own question
  // text still visibly bundles several distinct asks (e.g. "What is a tracer?
  // State some uses... Why is it important...?" is one bank Q&A pair, but its
  // own combined answer clearly has 3 parts). Build "pseudo" sub-items directly
  // from the exam question's own sentences instead, merging a contentless
  // connector line ("Explain.", "Why?") into the sentence before it so it
  // never becomes its own colour.
  const qSegs = splitIntoColorSegments(part && part.q);
  const merged = [];
  qSegs.forEach(seg => {
    if(merged.length && mqContentWords(seg).length === 0){
      merged[merged.length - 1] += ' ' + seg;
    } else {
      merged.push(seg);
    }
  });
  if(merged.length >= 2) return merged.map(q => ({ q, a: q }));
  return null;
}
function countSubQuestions(part){
  const items = typeof part === 'object' ? subQuestionItems(part) : null;
  return items ? items.length : 1;
}
const MQ_STOPWORDS = new Set(['what','give','some','with','from','that','this','their','which','does','when','have','also','many','type','types','main','other','each','into','your','about','would','could','should','there','these','those','while','being','were','then','than','only','such','used','using','uses','write','down','state','explain','describe','differences','difference','between','they','them']);
function mqStem(w){
  if(w.length > 4 && w.endsWith('ies')) return w.slice(0, -3) + 'y';
  if(w.length > 4 && w.endsWith('es') && (w.endsWith('ches') || w.endsWith('shes') || w.endsWith('xes'))) return w.slice(0, -2);
  if(w.length > 4 && w.endsWith('s') && !w.endsWith('ss')) return w.slice(0, -1);
  return w;
}
function mqContentWords(s){
  return (s || '').toLowerCase().replace(/\[table\][\s\S]*?\[\/table\]/gi, ' ').replace(/[^a-z0-9\s]/g, ' ').split(/\s+/).filter(w => w.length >= 4 && !MQ_STOPWORDS.has(w)).map(mqStem);
}
function mqOverlapScore(a, b){
  const wa = mqContentWords(a);
  const wb = new Set(mqContentWords(b));
  let score = 0;
  wa.forEach(w => { if(wb.has(w)) score++; });
  return score;
}
// Split text into colour-able segments: each sentence/sub-part from
// breakMultiQuestions is its own segment, but a [TABLE]...[/TABLE] block is
// protected as ONE opaque segment first, so its internal row-newlines never
// get sliced apart by the per-line split.
function splitIntoColorSegments(text){
  const tableBlocks = [];
  const protectedText = (text || '').replace(/\[TABLE\][\s\S]*?\[\/TABLE\]/g, (m) => {
    tableBlocks.push(m);
    return `@@CSEGTBL${tableBlocks.length - 1}@@`;
  });
  const lines = breakMultiQuestions(protectedText).split('\n').map(l => l.trim()).filter(Boolean);
  return lines.map(line => {
    const m = line.match(/^@@CSEGTBL(\d+)@@$/);
    return m ? tableBlocks[Number(m[1])] : line;
  });
}
// Assign each segment to the bank sub-question it best matches by shared
// keywords against that bank item's own "field" text (its "q" when colouring
// the question card, its "a" when colouring the solution) — far more
// reliable than guessing from line position or answer length, since neither
// the question's sentence order nor the written solution's paragraph order
// is guaranteed to march in lockstep with the bank's Q.N order. A segment
// with no keyword match at all (a short connector line) just stays in
// whichever bucket the previous segment landed in, and buckets only ever
// move forward, so the colouring stays a small number of contiguous blocks.
function mqAssignBuckets(segments, items, field){
  let cur = 0;
  return segments.map(seg => {
    let best = -1, bestScore = 0;
    items.forEach((it, idx) => {
      const score = mqOverlapScore(seg, it[field] || '');
      if(score > bestScore){ bestScore = score; best = idx; }
    });
    if(best === -1 || bestScore < 2) return cur;
    cur = Math.max(cur, best);
    return cur;
  });
}
const mqBucketMapCache = new WeakMap();
// Some sub-questions never get a distinct answer paragraph of their own (the
// solution folds them into a neighbouring sub-question's sentence, or the
// question's own lead-in has no answer at all). Colouring those as their own
// bucket would either show an empty/duplicate colour or make the Question and
// Solution colour counts disagree. So we always derive the bucket layout from
// which sub-questions the SOLUTION text actually addresses, then reuse that
// same compressed layout (fewer buckets, renumbered) for the Question side too.
function mqUsedBucketsMap(part, items){
  if(mqBucketMapCache.has(part)) return mqBucketMapCache.get(part);
  const solText = (part && (part.sol !== undefined ? part.sol : part.a)) || '';
  const segsA = splitIntoColorSegments(solText);
  const rawA = mqAssignBuckets(segsA, items, 'a');
  const used = Array.from(new Set(rawA)).sort((a, b) => a - b);
  if(used.length === 0) used.push(0);
  const map = {};
  used.forEach((b, i) => { map[b] = i; });
  const translate = (raw) => {
    let best = used[0];
    for(const u of used){ if(u <= raw) best = u; else break; }
    return map[best];
  };
  const result = { translate, nc: used.length };
  mqBucketMapCache.set(part, result);
  return result;
}
function renderColoredShort(text, part, field){
  const items = subQuestionItems(part);
  if(!items) return formatMath(breakMultiQuestions(text || ''));
  const segments = splitIntoColorSegments(text);
  if(segments.length === 0) return formatMath(breakMultiQuestions(text || ''));
  const bmap = mqUsedBucketsMap(part, items);
  const nc = bmap.nc;
  const rawBuckets = mqAssignBuckets(segments, items, field);
  const buckets = rawBuckets.map(b => bmap.translate(b));
  // Group consecutive same-bucket segments into one coloured wrapper, letting
  // formatMath render each group's own multi-line text (equation chains,
  // tables) exactly as it would the whole solution — only the grouping and
  // colour boundary are new here.
  const groups = [];
  segments.forEach((seg, idx) => {
    const b = buckets[idx] % nc;
    if(groups.length && groups[groups.length - 1].bucket === b){
      groups[groups.length - 1].segs.push(seg);
    } else {
      groups.push({ bucket: b, segs: [seg] });
    }
  });
  return groups.map(g => {
    const color = MQ_COLORS[g.bucket];
    const html = formatMath(g.segs.join('\n'));
    return `<div style="background:${color};border-radius:6px;padding:6px 9px;margin:3px 0;">${html}</div>`;
  }).join('');
}

// ---------- shuffling (so repeat attempts don't sit in the same positions) ----------
function shuffleArray(arr){
  const copy = arr.slice();
  for(let i = copy.length - 1; i > 0; i--){
    const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
    [copy[i], copy[j]] = [copy[j], copy[i]];
  }
  return copy;
}
function buildShuffledExam(set){
  const tf = shuffleArray(set.tf);
  const fib = shuffleArray(set.fib);
  const mcq = shuffleArray(set.mcq).map(item=>{
    const options = shuffleArray([
      {letter:'A', text:item.a, correct: item.answer==='A'},
      {letter:'B', text:item.b, correct: item.answer==='B'},
      {letter:'C', text:item.c, correct: item.answer==='C'}
    ]);
    const letters = ['A','B','C'];
    let newAnswer = 'A';
    options.forEach((opt,idx)=>{ if(opt.correct) newAnswer = letters[idx]; });
    return { q:item.q, a:options[0].text, b:options[1].text, c:options[2].text, answer:newAnswer };
  });
  return { tf, fib, mcq };
}

// ---------- custom modal (replaces window.confirm/alert, which don't work in every webview) ----------
function showConfirm(message){
  return new Promise(resolve=>{
    const overlay = document.getElementById('modal-overlay');
    document.getElementById('modal-message').textContent = message;
    const actions = document.getElementById('modal-actions');
    actions.innerHTML = '';
    const cancelBtn = document.createElement('button');
    cancelBtn.type = 'button'; cancelBtn.className = 'ghost'; cancelBtn.textContent = 'မလုပ်တော့ပါ';
    const okBtn = document.createElement('button');
    okBtn.type = 'button'; okBtn.className = 'danger'; okBtn.textContent = 'အတည်ပြုမည်';
    actions.appendChild(cancelBtn); actions.appendChild(okBtn);
    const close = (result)=>{ overlay.classList.add('hidden'); resolve(result); };
    cancelBtn.addEventListener('click', ()=>close(false));
    okBtn.addEventListener('click', ()=>close(true));
    overlay.classList.remove('hidden');
  });
}
function showAlert(message){
  return new Promise(resolve=>{
    const overlay = document.getElementById('modal-overlay');
    document.getElementById('modal-message').textContent = message;
    const actions = document.getElementById('modal-actions');
    actions.innerHTML = '';
    const okBtn = document.createElement('button');
    okBtn.type = 'button'; okBtn.className = 'danger'; okBtn.textContent = 'OK';
    actions.appendChild(okBtn);
    const close = ()=>{ overlay.classList.add('hidden'); resolve(); };
    okBtn.addEventListener('click', close);
    overlay.classList.remove('hidden');
  });
}

// ---------- view switching ----------
function showView(name){
  ['trial-gate','login','home','browse','chapter','notes','formula','units','definitions','problems','shortq','drawing','examIntro','exam','result'].forEach(v=>{
    document.getElementById(v+'-view').classList.toggle('hidden', v!==name);
  });
  renderBreadcrumb(name);
  window.scrollTo({top:0, behavior:'smooth'});
  if(typeof updateScrollButtons === 'function') updateScrollButtons();
  const logoutRow = document.getElementById('logout-row');
  if(logoutRow) logoutRow.classList.toggle('show', name!=='login' && name!=='trial-gate');
  const calcFab = document.getElementById('calc-fab');
  if(calcFab) calcFab.classList.toggle('show', name==='problems');
}
function renderBreadcrumb(view){
  const bc = document.getElementById('breadcrumb');
  if(view==='home' || view==='login' || view==='trial-gate'){ bc.innerHTML=''; return; }
  let parts = [`<button id="bc-home">🏠 Home</button>`];
  parts.push(`<span class="sep">›</span><button id="bc-category">${escapeHtml(CATEGORIES[currentCategory].label)}</button>`);
  if(currentCategory === 'practice' && practiceBrowseMode){
    const pModeLabel = practiceBrowseMode === 'main' ? 'Chapter Exams' : 'Additional';
    parts.push(`<span class="sep">›</span><button id="bc-pmode">${pModeLabel}</button>`);
  }
  if(currentCategory === 'practice' && practiceBrowseMode === 'additional' && pastBrowseMode){
    const modeLabel = pastBrowseMode === 'chapter' ? 'Chapter အလိုက်' : 'ခုနှစ်အလိုက်';
    parts.push(`<span class="sep">›</span><button id="bc-mode">${modeLabel}</button>`);
  }
  if(currentCategory === 'practice' && practiceBrowseMode === 'main' && currentChapter){
    parts.push(`<span class="sep">›</span><button id="bc-chapter">Chapter ${currentChapter}</button>`);
  }
  if(currentCategory === 'notes' && currentChapter){
    parts.push(`<span class="sep">›</span><button id="bc-chapter">Chapter ${currentChapter}</button>`);
  }
  if(currentCategory === 'formula' && currentChapter){
    parts.push(`<span class="sep">›</span><button id="bc-chapter">Chapter ${currentChapter}</button>`);
  }
  if(currentCategory === 'units' && currentChapter){
    parts.push(`<span class="sep">›</span><button id="bc-chapter">Chapter ${currentChapter}</button>`);
  }
  if(currentCategory === 'definitions' && currentChapter){
    parts.push(`<span class="sep">›</span><button id="bc-chapter">Chapter ${currentChapter}</button>`);
  }
  if(currentCategory === 'problems' && currentChapter){
    parts.push(`<span class="sep">›</span><button id="bc-chapter">Chapter ${currentChapter}</button>`);
  }
  if(currentCategory === 'shortq' && currentChapter){
    parts.push(`<span class="sep">›</span><button id="bc-chapter">Chapter ${currentChapter}</button>`);
  }
  if(currentCategory === 'drawing' && currentChapter){
    parts.push(`<span class="sep">›</span><button id="bc-chapter">Chapter ${currentChapter}</button>`);
  }
  if(pastBrowseMode === 'chapter' && currentChapter){
    parts.push(`<span class="sep">›</span><button id="bc-chapter">Chapter ${currentChapter}</button>`);
  }
  if(pastBrowseMode === 'year' && currentYear){
    parts.push(`<span class="sep">›</span><button id="bc-year">${currentYear}</button>`);
  }
  if(currentCategory === 'past' && pastBrowseMode === 'fullset' && currentYear){
    parts.push(`<span class="sep">›</span><button id="bc-year">${currentYear}</button>`);
  }
  if((view==='examIntro' || view==='exam' || view==='result') && currentSet){
    parts.push(`<span class="sep">›</span><span>${escapeHtml(currentSet.title)}</span>`);
  }
  if(view==='problems' && pastBrowseMode === 'fullset' && currentSet){
    parts.push(`<span class="sep">›</span><span>${escapeHtml(currentSet.title)}</span>`);
  }
  bc.innerHTML = parts.join('');
  const h = document.getElementById('bc-home'); if(h) h.addEventListener('click', ()=> renderHome());
  const cat = document.getElementById('bc-category'); if(cat) cat.addEventListener('click', ()=> renderHome(currentCategory));
  const pm = document.getElementById('bc-pmode'); if(pm) pm.addEventListener('click', ()=> selectPracticeMode(practiceBrowseMode));
  const m = document.getElementById('bc-mode'); if(m) m.addEventListener('click', ()=> selectPastMode(pastBrowseMode));
  const c = document.getElementById('bc-chapter'); if(c) c.addEventListener('click', ()=>{
    if(currentCategory === 'practice' && pastBrowseMode === 'chapter') openPastChapter(currentChapter);
    else if(currentCategory === 'practice') openChapter(currentChapter);
    else if(currentCategory === 'notes') openNotesChapter(currentChapter);
    else if(currentCategory === 'formula') openFormulaChapter(currentChapter);
    else if(currentCategory === 'units') openUnitsChapter(currentChapter);
    else if(currentCategory === 'definitions') openDefinitionsChapter(currentChapter);
    else if(currentCategory === 'problems') openProblemsChapter(currentChapter);
    else if(currentCategory === 'shortq') openShortQChapter(currentChapter);
    else if(currentCategory === 'drawing') openDrawingChapter(currentChapter);
  });
  const y = document.getElementById('bc-year'); if(y) y.addEventListener('click', ()=>{
    if(pastBrowseMode === 'fullset') openFullSetYear(currentYear);
    else openPastYear(currentYear);
  });
}

// tap-to-highlight: colors a chapter/year card as soon as it's tapped, before the app navigates away
function bindChapterCardSelection(grid){
  if(grid.dataset.selBound) return;
  grid.dataset.selBound = '1';
  grid.addEventListener('click', (e)=>{
    const card = e.target.closest('.chapter-card:not(.empty):not(.locked)');
    if(!card || !grid.contains(card)) return;
    grid.querySelectorAll('.chapter-card.selected').forEach(c=>c.classList.remove('selected'));
    card.classList.add('selected');
  });
}

// ---------- PAST QUESTIONS: mode selection + browse grid ----------
function selectPastMode(mode){
  pastBrowseMode = mode;
  currentChapter = null; currentYear = null; currentSet = null;
  const grid = document.getElementById('browse-grid');
  bindChapterCardSelection(grid);
  if(mode === 'chapter'){
    document.getElementById('browse-title').textContent = 'Past Questions — Chapter အလိုက်';
    document.getElementById('browse-subtitle').textContent = 'Chapter ရွေးပါ';
    grid.innerHTML = Array.from({length:CHAPTER_COUNT}, (_,i)=>i+1).map(n=>{
      const setCount = pastSetsByChapter(n).length;
      return `
      <div class="chapter-card ${setCount ? '' : 'empty'}" data-chapter="${n}">
        <div class="chicon">${CHAPTER_ICONS[n] || "📘"}</div>
        <div class="num mono">CH.${n}</div>
        <div class="ctitle">Chapter ${n}</div>
        <div class="count mono">${setCount ? setCount+' set(s)' : 'မေးခွန်းမရှိသေး'}</div>
      </div>`;
    }).join('');
    grid.querySelectorAll('.chapter-card:not(.empty)').forEach(card=>{
      card.addEventListener('click', ()=> openPastChapter(Number(card.dataset.chapter)));
    });
  } else if(mode === 'year'){
    document.getElementById('browse-title').textContent = 'Past Questions — ခုနှစ်အလိုက်';
    document.getElementById('browse-subtitle').textContent = 'ခုနှစ် ရွေးပါ';
    const years = pastAvailableYears();
    if(years.length===0){
      grid.innerHTML = `<p class="note">ခုနှစ်အလိုက် Past Question မရှိသေးပါ။</p>`;
    } else {
      grid.innerHTML = years.map(y=>{
        const setCount = pastSetsByYear(y).length;
        return `
        <div class="chapter-card" data-year="${y}">
          <div class="num mono">${y}</div>
          <div class="ctitle">ခုနှစ်</div>
          <div class="count mono">${setCount} set(s)</div>
        </div>`;
      }).join('');
      grid.querySelectorAll('.chapter-card').forEach(card=>{
        card.addEventListener('click', ()=> openPastYear(card.dataset.year));
      });
    }
  } else {
    // 'fullset' — full-paper reading mode, grouped by year, no timer/grading
    document.getElementById('browse-title').textContent = 'Past Questions — Set အစုံလိုက်';
    document.getElementById('browse-subtitle').textContent = 'ခုနှစ် ရွေးပါ';
    const years = [...new Set([...pastAvailableYears(), 2026])].sort((a,b)=> b-a);
    grid.innerHTML = years.map(y=>{
      const setCount = pastSetsByYear(y).length;
      return `
      <div class="chapter-card ${setCount ? '' : 'empty'}" data-fullset-year="${y}">
        <div class="num mono">${y}</div>
        <div class="ctitle">ခုနှစ်</div>
        <div class="count mono">${setCount ? setCount+' set(s)' : 'Set မရှိသေးပါ'}</div>
      </div>`;
    }).join('');
    grid.querySelectorAll('.chapter-card:not(.empty)').forEach(card=>{
      card.addEventListener('click', ()=> openFullSetYear(card.dataset.fullsetYear));
    });
  }
  showView('browse');
}
async function openPastChapter(n){
  currentChapter = n;
  await renderCurrentSetList();
  showView('chapter');
}
async function openPastYear(year){
  currentYear = year;
  await renderCurrentSetList();
  showView('chapter');
}

// ---------- PRACTICE EXAMS: top-level mode select (Chapter Exams / Additional) ----------
function selectPracticeMode(mode){
  if(mode === 'additional' && !isAdminUser) mode = 'main'; // Additional (past-set browsing) is admin-only
  practiceBrowseMode = mode;
  currentChapter = null; currentYear = null; currentSet = null;
  if(mode === 'additional'){
    pastBrowseMode = null;
    const grid = document.getElementById('browse-grid');
    bindChapterCardSelection(grid);
    document.getElementById('browse-title').textContent = 'Practice Exams — Additional';
    document.getElementById('browse-subtitle').textContent = 'ရွေးပါ';
    grid.innerHTML = `
      <div class="chapter-card" data-mode="chapter">
        <div class="num mono">📘</div>
        <div class="ctitle">Chapter အလိုက်</div>
        <div class="count mono">${(()=>{const n=PAST_SETS.filter(s=>s.chapter!=null).length; return n ? n+' total set(s)' : 'Chapter 1–13';})()}</div>
      </div>
      <div class="chapter-card" data-mode="year">
        <div class="num mono">🗓️</div>
        <div class="ctitle">ခုနှစ်အလိုက်</div>
        <div class="count mono">${pastAvailableYears().length ? pastAvailableYears().length+' year(s)' : 'ခုနှစ်များ'}</div>
      </div>`;
    grid.querySelectorAll('.chapter-card').forEach(card=>{
      card.addEventListener('click', ()=> selectPastMode(card.dataset.mode));
    });
    showView('browse');
  } else {
    pastBrowseMode = null;
    renderPracticeMainGrid();
    showView('home');
  }
}
function renderPracticeMainGrid(){
  const grid = document.getElementById('chapter-grid');
  bindChapterCardSelection(grid);
  grid.innerHTML = Array.from({length:CHAPTER_COUNT}, (_,i)=>i+1).map(n=>{
    const ch = PRACTICE_CHAPTERS[n];
    const setCount = ch && ch.sets ? ch.sets.length : 0;
    const locked = isTrialUser && n !== 1;
    if(locked){
      return `
      <div class="chapter-card locked" data-chapter="${n}">
        <div class="lock-icon">🔒</div>
        <div class="ctitle">Chapter ${n}</div>
        <div class="count mono">အစမ်းသုံးကာလ မဖွင့်သေးပါ</div>
      </div>`;
    }
    return `
    <div class="chapter-card ${setCount ? '' : 'empty'}" data-chapter="${n}">
      <div class="chicon">${CHAPTER_ICONS[n] || "📘"}</div>
      <div class="num mono">CH.${n}</div>
      <div class="ctitle">Chapter ${n}</div>
      <div class="count mono">${setCount ? setCount+' set(s)' : 'မေးခွန်းမရှိသေး'}</div>
    </div>`;
  }).join('');
  grid.querySelectorAll('.chapter-card:not(.empty):not(.locked)').forEach(card=>{
    card.addEventListener('click', ()=> openChapter(Number(card.dataset.chapter)));
  });
}

// ---------- PAST QUESTIONS: "Set အစုံလိုက်" (full-paper reading mode) ----------
function openFullSetYear(year){
  currentYear = year;
  const grid = document.getElementById('browse-grid');
  bindChapterCardSelection(grid);
  document.getElementById('browse-title').textContent = `Set အစုံလိုက် — ${year}`;
  document.getElementById('browse-subtitle').textContent = 'Set ရွေးပါ';
  const sets = pastSetsByYear(year);
  grid.innerHTML = sets.length ? sets.map(s=>`
    <div class="chapter-card" data-fullset-id="${escapeHtml(s.id)}">
      <div class="num mono">📄</div>
      <div class="ctitle">${escapeHtml(s.title)}</div>
      <div class="count mono">${(s.sectionB && s.sectionB.length) ? 'Section A + B' : 'Section A'}</div>
    </div>`).join('') : `<p class="note">${year} အတွက် Set အစုံလိုက် မရှိသေးပါ။</p>`;
  grid.querySelectorAll('[data-fullset-id]').forEach(card=>{
    card.addEventListener('click', ()=> openFullSet(card.dataset.fullsetId));
  });
  showView('browse');
}
function openFullSet(id){
  const set = PAST_SETS.find(s=>s.id===id);
  if(!set) return;
  currentSet = set;
  document.getElementById('problems-title').textContent = set.title;
  document.getElementById('problems-search-input').value = '';
  document.getElementById('problems-search-msg').style.display = 'none';
  const tfHtml = (set.tf||[]).map((it,i)=>`
    <div class="problem-item">
      <div class="problem-head"><span class="mono">${i+1}.</span> True / False — Q1(${ROMAN[i]||i+1})</div>
      <div class="sec-block"><div class="sec-label sec-q">📝 Statement</div><div class="problem-q">${formatMath(it.q)}</div></div>
      <div class="problem-toggle-row"><button type="button" class="answer-toggle-btn key-toggle-btn" data-target="fs-tf-${i}">အဖြေ ကြည့်ရန် ▾</button></div>
      <div class="sec-block problem-a hidden" id="fs-tf-${i}"><div class="sec-label sec-ans">✅ Answer</div>${formatMath(it.answer)}${it.hint ? `<p class="note" style="margin-top:6px;">💡 ${formatMath(it.hint)}</p>` : ''}</div>
    </div>`).join('');
  const fibHtml = (set.fib||[]).map((it,i)=>`
    <div class="problem-item">
      <div class="problem-head"><span class="mono">${i+1}.</span> Fill in the Blank — Q2(${ROMAN[i]||i+1})</div>
      <div class="sec-block"><div class="sec-label sec-q">📝 Fill in the Blank</div><div class="problem-q">${formatMath(it.q)}</div></div>
      <div class="problem-toggle-row"><button type="button" class="answer-toggle-btn key-toggle-btn" data-target="fs-fib-${i}">အဖြေ ကြည့်ရန် ▾</button></div>
      <div class="sec-block problem-a hidden" id="fs-fib-${i}"><div class="sec-label sec-ans">✅ Answer</div>${formatMath(it.answer.split('|')[0])}</div>
    </div>`).join('');
  const mcqHtml = (set.mcq||[]).map((it,i)=>`
    <div class="problem-item">
      <div class="problem-head"><span class="mono">${i+1}.</span> MCQ — Q3(${ROMAN[i]||i+1})</div>
      <div class="sec-block">
        <div class="sec-label sec-q">📝 Question</div>
        <div class="problem-q">${formatMath(it.q)}</div>
        <div class="note" style="margin-top:6px;line-height:1.6;">(A) ${formatMath(it.a)}<br>(B) ${formatMath(it.b)}<br>(C) ${formatMath(it.c)}</div>
      </div>
      <div class="problem-toggle-row"><button type="button" class="answer-toggle-btn key-toggle-btn" data-target="fs-mcq-${i}">အဖြေ ကြည့်ရန် ▾</button></div>
      <div class="sec-block problem-a hidden" id="fs-mcq-${i}"><div class="sec-label sec-ans">✅ Answer</div>${escapeHtml(it.answer)}</div>
    </div>`).join('');
  const sbFlatParts = [];
  (set.sectionB || []).forEach(it => {
    (it.parts || []).forEach(part => {
      sbFlatParts.push({ name: it.name, part });
    });
  });
  const sectionBHtml = sbFlatParts.length ? sbFlatParts.map(({name, part}, i)=>`
    <div class="problem-item" data-name="${escapeHtml(name || '')}">
      <div class="problem-head"><span class="mono">${i+1}.</span> ${escapeHtml(name || '')} — ${escapeHtml(part.label || '')}</div>
      <div class="sec-block">
        <div class="sec-label sec-q">📝 Question</div>
        <div class="problem-q">${part.type === 'short' ? renderColoredShort(part.q, part, 'q') : formatMath(breakMultiQuestions(part.q))}</div>
        ${part.source ? `<div class="source-tag">📎 ${escapeHtml(part.source)}</div>` : ''}
      </div>
      <div class="problem-toggle-row">
        ${part.img ? `<button type="button" class="answer-toggle-btn img-toggle-btn" data-target="fs-imgb-${i}">ပုံ ကြည့်ရန် ▾</button>` : ''}
        ${(part.sol && part.type !== 'diagram') ? `<button type="button" class="answer-toggle-btn sol-toggle-btn" data-target="fs-solb-${i}">Solution ▾</button>` : ''}
      </div>
      ${part.img ? `<div class="sec-block problem-imgwrap hidden" id="fs-imgb-${i}">${Array.isArray(part.img) ? part.img.map(u=>`<img src="${u}" class="problem-img" alt="figure">`).join('') : `<img src="${part.img}" class="problem-img" alt="figure">`}</div>` : ''}
      ${(part.sol && part.type !== 'diagram') ? `<div class="sec-block problem-sol hidden" id="fs-solb-${i}"><div class="sec-label sec-sol">🧮 Solution</div>${part.type === 'short' ? renderColoredShort(part.sol, part, 'a') : formatMath(part.type === 'calc' ? part.sol : breakMultiQuestions(part.sol))}</div>` : ''}
    </div>`).join('') : `<p class="note">Section (B) — Long Answer Questions အချက်အလက်များ မထည့်ရသေးပါ။</p>`;
  const scanHtml = (set.scanImages && set.scanImages.length) ? `<div class="scan-imgwrap">${set.scanImages.map((u,i)=>`<img src="${u}" class="scan-page-img" alt="Original exam page ${i+1}" loading="lazy">`).join('')}</div>` : `<p class="note">ဤ Set အတွက် မူရင်းပုံများ မတင်ရသေးပါ။</p>`;
  document.getElementById('problems-list').innerHTML = `
    <div class="fs-tabs" style="display:flex;gap:8px;margin-bottom:16px;flex-wrap:wrap;">
      <button type="button" class="fs-tab-btn active" data-fstab="a">Section (A)</button>
      <button type="button" class="fs-tab-btn" data-fstab="b">Section (B)</button>
      <button type="button" class="fs-tab-btn" data-fstab="scan">မူရင်းပုံ</button>
    </div>
    <div id="fs-panel-a">
      <h3 class="mono" style="font-size:14px;margin:0 0 10px;">Section (A) — True/False, Fill in the Blank, MCQ</h3>
      ${tfHtml}${fibHtml}${mcqHtml}
    </div>
    <div id="fs-panel-b" class="hidden">
      <h3 class="mono" style="font-size:14px;margin:0 0 10px;">Section (B) — Long Answer Questions</h3>
      ${sectionBHtml}
    </div>
    <div id="fs-panel-scan" class="hidden">
      <h3 class="mono" style="font-size:14px;margin:0 0 10px;">မူရင်းစာမေးပွဲပုံများ (Original Scanned Pages)</h3>
      ${scanHtml}
    </div>
  `;
  document.querySelectorAll('.fs-tab-btn').forEach(btn=>{
    btn.addEventListener('click', ()=>{
      document.querySelectorAll('.fs-tab-btn').forEach(b=>b.classList.remove('active'));
      btn.classList.add('active');
      document.getElementById('fs-panel-a').classList.toggle('hidden', btn.dataset.fstab !== 'a');
      document.getElementById('fs-panel-scan').classList.toggle('hidden', btn.dataset.fstab !== 'scan');
      document.getElementById('fs-panel-b').classList.toggle('hidden', btn.dataset.fstab !== 'b');
      window.scrollTo({top:0, behavior:'smooth'});
    });
  });
  document.querySelectorAll('.key-toggle-btn').forEach(btn=>{
    btn.addEventListener('click', ()=>{
      const el = document.getElementById(btn.dataset.target);
      el.classList.toggle('hidden');
      btn.textContent = el.classList.contains('hidden') ? 'အဖြေ ကြည့်ရန် ▾' : 'အဖြေ ဖျောက်ရန် ▴';
    });
  });
  document.querySelectorAll('.sol-toggle-btn').forEach(btn=>{
    btn.addEventListener('click', ()=>{
      const el = document.getElementById(btn.dataset.target);
      el.classList.toggle('hidden');
      btn.textContent = el.classList.contains('hidden') ? 'Solution ▾' : 'Solution ဖျောက်ရန် ▴';
    });
  });
  document.querySelectorAll('.img-toggle-btn').forEach(btn=>{
    btn.addEventListener('click', ()=>{
      const el = document.getElementById(btn.dataset.target);
      el.classList.toggle('hidden');
      btn.textContent = el.classList.contains('hidden') ? 'ပုံ ကြည့်ရန် ▾' : 'ပုံ ဖျောက်ရန် ▴';
    });
  });
  showView('problems');
}

// ---------- UNITS (symbol / quantity / SI unit table + unit conversions per chapter) ----------
function openUnitsChapter(n){
  stopTimer();
  currentChapter = n;
  const u = UNITS[n];
  document.getElementById('units-title').textContent = u ? u.title : `Chapter ${n}`;
  let html = '';
  if(u){
    html += `<div class="units-table-wrap"><table class="units-table"><thead><tr><th>သင်္ကေတ</th><th>ပမာဏ (Quantity)</th><th>SI Unit</th></tr></thead><tbody>`;
    html += u.table.map(row => `<tr><td>${formatMath(row.sym)}</td><td>${escapeHtml(row.qty)}</td><td>${formatMath(row.unit)}</td></tr>`).join('');
    html += `</tbody></table></div>`;
    if(u.conversions && u.conversions.length){
      html += `<h3 class="units-conv-heading">Unit Conversion</h3><div class="units-conv-list">`;
      html += u.conversions.map(c => `<div class="units-conv-item">${formatMath(c)}</div>`).join('');
      html += `</div>`;
    }
  } else {
    html = `<p class="note">ဒီ Chapter အတွက် Units မရှိသေးပါ။</p>`;
  }
  document.getElementById('units-list').innerHTML = html;
  showView('units');
}

// ---------- DEFINITIONS (official term definitions per chapter) ----------
function openDefinitionsChapter(n){
  stopTimer();
  currentChapter = n;
  const d = DEFINITIONS[n];
  document.getElementById('definitions-title').textContent = d ? d.title : `Chapter ${n}`;
  document.getElementById('definitions-list').innerHTML = d
    ? d.items.map((it, i) => {
        if(it.rows){
          return `
            <div class="comparison-block">
              <div class="definition-head"><span class="mono">${i+1}</span><span class="definition-term">${escapeHtml(it.t)}</span>${it.tags && it.tags.length ? it.tags.map(t=>`<span class="sq-examtag">${escapeHtml(t)}</span>`).join('') : ''}</div>
              <div class="comparison-table-wrap">
                <div class="comparison-head"><div>${escapeHtml(it.headers[0])}</div><div>${escapeHtml(it.headers[1])}</div></div>
                ${it.rows.map(r => `
                  <div class="comparison-row">
                    <div><span class="comparison-col-label">${escapeHtml(it.headers[0])}</span>${formatMath(r[0])}</div>
                    <div><span class="comparison-col-label">${escapeHtml(it.headers[1])}</span>${formatMath(r[1])}</div>
                  </div>`).join('')}
              </div>
            </div>`;
        }
        return `
        <div class="definition-item">
          <div class="definition-head"><span class="mono">${i+1}</span><span class="definition-term">${escapeHtml(it.t)}</span>${it.tags && it.tags.length ? it.tags.map(t=>`<span class="sq-examtag">${escapeHtml(t)}</span>`).join('') : ''}</div>
          <div class="definition-desc">${formatMath(it.d)}</div>
        </div>`;
      }).join('')
    : `<p class="note">ဒီ Chapter အတွက် Definitions မရှိသေးပါ။</p>`;
  showView('definitions');
}

}

// ---------- PROBLEMS (worked example problems from past exercise books) ----------
function openProblemsChapter(n){
  stopTimer();
  currentChapter = n;
  const p = PROBLEMS[n];
  document.getElementById('problems-title').textContent = p ? p.title : `Chapter ${n}`;
  document.getElementById('problems-search-input').value = '';
  document.getElementById('problems-search-msg').style.display = 'none';
  document.getElementById('problems-list').innerHTML = p
    ? p.items.map((it, i) => `
        <div class="problem-item" data-ref="${escapeHtml(it.ref || '')}" data-name="${escapeHtml(it.name || '')}">
          <div class="problem-head"><span class="mono">${i+1}.</span> ${escapeHtml(it.name)}${it.ref ? ` <span class="problem-ref">(${escapeHtml(it.ref)})</span>` : ''}</div>
          <div class="sec-block">
            <div class="sec-label sec-q">📝 Question</div>
            <div class="problem-q">${formatMath(it.q)}</div>
            ${it.q_mm ? `<div class="problem-mm hidden" id="prob-mm-${n}-${i}">${formatMath(it.q_mm)}</div>` : ''}
          </div>
          <div class="problem-toggle-row">

            ${it.sol ? `<button type="button" class="answer-toggle-btn sol-toggle-btn" data-target="prob-sol-${n}-${i}">Solution အပြည့်အစုံ ▾</button>` : ''}
            ${it.q_mm ? `<button type="button" class="answer-toggle-btn mm-toggle-btn" data-target="prob-mm-${n}-${i}">မြန်မာပြန် ▾</button>` : ''}
            ${it.tags && it.tags.length ? `<button type="button" class="answer-toggle-btn tag-toggle-btn" data-target="prob-tags-${n}-${i}">Tags ကြည့်ရန် ▾</button>` : ''}
          </div>
          ${it.tags && it.tags.length ? `<div class="tag-row hidden" id="prob-tags-${n}-${i}">${it.tags.map(t=>`<span class="sq-examtag">${escapeHtml(t)}</span>`).join('')}</div>` : ''}
          ${it.img ? `<div class="sec-block problem-imgwrap hidden" id="prob-img-${n}-${i}"><img src="${it.img}" class="problem-img" alt="figure"></div>` : ''}
          <div class="sec-block problem-a hidden" id="prob-ans-${n}-${i}"><div class="sec-label sec-ans">✅ Answer</div>${formatMath(it.a)}</div>
          ${it.sol ? `<div class="sec-block problem-sol hidden" id="prob-sol-${n}-${i}"><div class="sec-label sec-sol">🧮 Solution</div>${it.solImg ? (Array.isArray(it.solImg) ? it.solImg.map(u=>`<img src="${u}" class="problem-img sol-img" alt="solution diagram">`).join('') : `<img src="${it.solImg}" class="problem-img sol-img" alt="solution diagram">`) : ''}${formatMath(it.sol)}</div>` : ''}
        </div>`).join('')
    : `<p class="note">ဒီ Chapter အတွက် Problems မရှိသေးပါ။</p>`;
  document.querySelectorAll('.key-toggle-btn').forEach(btn=>{
    btn.addEventListener('click', ()=>{
      const el = document.getElementById(btn.dataset.target);
      el.classList.toggle('hidden');
      btn.textContent = el.classList.contains('hidden') ? 'Key ကြည့်ရန် ▾' : 'Key ဖျောက်ရန် ▴';
    });
  });
  document.querySelectorAll('.sol-toggle-btn').forEach(btn=>{
    btn.addEventListener('click', ()=>{
      const el = document.getElementById(btn.dataset.target);
      el.classList.toggle('hidden');
      btn.textContent = el.classList.contains('hidden') ? 'Solution အပြည့်အစုံ ▾' : 'Solution ဖျောက်ရန် ▴';
    });
  });
  document.querySelectorAll('.mm-toggle-btn').forEach(btn=>{
    btn.addEventListener('click', ()=>{
      const el = document.getElementById(btn.dataset.target);
      el.classList.toggle('hidden');
      btn.textContent = el.classList.contains('hidden') ? 'မြန်မာပြန် ▾' : 'မြန်မာပြန် ဖျောက်ရန် ▴';
    });
  });
  document.querySelectorAll('.img-toggle-btn').forEach(btn=>{
    btn.addEventListener('click', ()=>{
      const el = document.getElementById(btn.dataset.target);
      el.classList.toggle('hidden');
      btn.textContent = el.classList.contains('hidden') ? 'ပုံ ကြည့်ရန် ▾' : 'ပုံ ဖျောက်ရန် ▴';
    });
  });
  document.querySelectorAll('.tag-toggle-btn').forEach(btn=>{
    btn.addEventListener('click', ()=>{
      const el = document.getElementById(btn.dataset.target);
      el.classList.toggle('hidden');
      btn.textContent = el.classList.contains('hidden') ? 'Tags ကြည့်ရန် ▾' : 'Tags ဖျောက်ရန် ▴';
    });

  showView('problems');
}

// ---------- SET LIST (shared by practice / past-by-chapter / past-by-year) ----------
function renderCurrentSetList(){
  let titleText, sets;
  if(pastBrowseMode === 'chapter'){
    titleText = `Chapter ${currentChapter} — Additional (Past Questions)`;
    sets = pastSetsByChapter(currentChapter);
  } else if(pastBrowseMode === 'year'){
    titleText = `${currentYear} — Additional (Past Questions)`;
    sets = pastSetsByYear(currentYear);
  } else {
    const ch = PRACTICE_CHAPTERS[currentChapter];
    titleText = ch ? ch.title : `Chapter ${currentChapter}`;
    sets = ch && ch.sets ? ch.sets : [];
  }
  document.getElementById('chapter-title').textContent = titleText;
  const list = document.getElementById('set-list');
  currentSetsList = sets;
  if(sets.length===0){
    list.innerHTML = `<p class="note">ဒီနေရာအတွက် မေးခွန်း မရှိသေးပါ။</p>`;
    return;
  }
  list.innerHTML = sets.map(set=>{
    const sc = myScores[set.id];
    return `
    <div class="set-card">
      <div>
        <div><b>${escapeHtml(set.title)}</b></div>
        <div class="meta">TF${set.tf.length} · FIB${set.fib.length} · MCQ${set.mcq.length} &nbsp;|&nbsp; Timer: ${set.timerMinutes} min</div>
        ${sc ? `<div class="myscore">This session — best: ${sc.best}/${set.tf.length+set.fib.length+set.mcq.length} · attempts: ${sc.attempts}</div>` : ''}
      </div>
      <div style="display:flex;gap:8px;">
        <button type="button" class="danger" data-id="${set.id}">ဖြေမည် →</button>
      </div>
    </div>`;
  }).join('');
  list.querySelectorAll('button[data-id]').forEach(b=> b.addEventListener('click', ()=> openExamIntro(b.dataset.id)));
}

// ---------- EXAM INTRO ----------
function openExamIntro(setId){
  currentSet = currentSetsList.find(s=>s.id===setId);
  document.getElementById('intro-set-title').textContent = currentSet.title;
  const tfN = currentSet.tf.length, fibN = currentSet.fib.length, mcqN = currentSet.mcq.length;
  document.getElementById('intro-breakdown').textContent =
    `True/False ${tfN} · Fill in the Blank ${fibN} · MCQ ${mcqN} — Total ${tfN+fibN+mcqN} marks`;
  document.getElementById('intro-timer-input').value = currentSet.timerMinutes;
  showView('examIntro');
}

// ---------- EXAM ----------
function renderExam(set){
  document.getElementById('exam-tf-mark').textContent = `/${set.tf.length}`;
  document.getElementById('exam-fib-mark').textContent = `/${set.fib.length}`;
  document.getElementById('exam-mcq-mark').textContent = `/${set.mcq.length}`;
  document.getElementById('exam-tf-list').innerHTML = set.tf.map((item,i)=>`
    <div class="q-block">
      <p class="mono" style="font-size:13px;color:var(--ink-soft);margin-bottom:2px;">(${ROMAN[i]})</p>
      <p class="q-text">${formatMath(item.q)}</p>
      <div class="answer-select">
        <label><input type="radio" name="ex-tf-${i}" value="True"> True</label>
        <label><input type="radio" name="ex-tf-${i}" value="False"> False</label>
      </div>
    </div>`).join('');

  document.getElementById('exam-fib-list').innerHTML = set.fib.map((item,i)=>`
    <div class="q-block">
      <p class="mono" style="font-size:13px;color:var(--ink-soft);margin-bottom:2px;">(${ROMAN[i]})</p>
      <p class="q-text">${formatMath(item.q)}</p>
      <input type="text" class="ex-fib-ans" data-i="${i}" placeholder="Type your answer...">
    </div>`).join('');

  document.getElementById('exam-mcq-list').innerHTML = set.mcq.map((item,i)=>`
    <div class="q-block">
      <p class="mono" style="font-size:13px;color:var(--ink-soft);margin-bottom:2px;">(${ROMAN[i]})</p>
      <p class="q-text">${formatMath(item.q)}</p>
      <div class="answer-select" style="flex-direction:column;gap:8px;">
        <label><input type="radio" name="ex-mcq-${i}" value="A"> A. ${formatMath(item.a)}</label>
        <label><input type="radio" name="ex-mcq-${i}" value="B"> B. ${formatMath(item.b)}</label>
        <label><input type="radio" name="ex-mcq-${i}" value="C"> C. ${formatMath(item.c)}</label>
      </div>
    </div>`).join('');

  document.querySelectorAll('#exam-view input').forEach(el=>{
    el.addEventListener('input', updateProgress);
    el.addEventListener('change', updateProgress);
  });
  updateProgress();
}
function updateProgress(){
  let answered = 0;
  const tfN = currentSet.tf.length, mcqN = currentSet.mcq.length;
  for(let i=0;i<tfN;i++) if(document.querySelector(`input[name="ex-tf-${i}"]:checked`)) answered++;
  for(let i=0;i<mcqN;i++) if(document.querySelector(`input[name="ex-mcq-${i}"]:checked`)) answered++;
  document.querySelectorAll('.ex-fib-ans').forEach(el=>{ if(el.value.trim()) answered++; });
  const total = tfN + currentSet.fib.length + mcqN;
  document.getElementById('progress-fill').style.width = (answered/total*100)+'%';
  document.getElementById('progress-label').textContent = `${answered} / ${total} ဖြေပြီး`;
}

function startExam(set, minutes){
  currentExamData = buildShuffledExam(set);
  renderExam(currentExamData);
  showView('exam');
  startTimer(minutes*60);
}
function startTimer(seconds){
  stopTimer();
  timerRemaining = seconds;
  updateTimerDisplay();
  timerInterval = setInterval(async ()=>{
    timerRemaining--;
    updateTimerDisplay();
    if(timerRemaining<=0){
      stopTimer();
      await showAlert('အချိန်ကုန်သွားပါပြီ! အလိုအလျောက် တင်သွင်းပါမည်။');
      submitExam();
    }
  }, 1000);
}
function stopTimer(){ if(timerInterval){ clearInterval(timerInterval); timerInterval=null; } }
function updateTimerDisplay(){
  const el = document.getElementById('timer-display');
  if(!el) return;
  const m = Math.max(0, Math.floor(timerRemaining/60));
  const s = Math.max(0, timerRemaining%60);
  el.textContent = `${String(m).padStart(2,'0')}:${String(s).padStart(2,'0')}`;
  el.classList.toggle('low', timerRemaining<=60);
}

// ---------- GRADING ----------
function gradeExam(set){
  const review = [];
  let tfScore=0, fibScore=0, mcqScore=0;
  set.tf.forEach((item,i)=>{
    const checked = document.querySelector(`input[name="ex-tf-${i}"]:checked`);
    const given = checked ? checked.value : '(မဖြေရသေး)';
    const correct = checked && checked.value === item.answer;
    if(correct) tfScore++;
    review.push({section:'TF', label:`(${ROMAN[i]})`, q:item.q, given, correctAns:item.answer, correct, hint:item.hint});
  });
  set.fib.forEach((item,i)=>{
    const el = document.querySelector(`.ex-fib-ans[data-i="${i}"]`);
    const given = el ? el.value.trim() : '';
    const accepted = item.answer.split('|').map(normalizeFib);
    const correct = given && accepted.includes(normalizeFib(given));
    if(correct) fibScore++;
    review.push({section:'Fill Blank', label:`(${ROMAN[i]})`, q:item.q, given: given || '(မဖြေရသေး)', correctAns:item.answer, correct});
  });
  set.mcq.forEach((item,i)=>{
    const checked = document.querySelector(`input[name="ex-mcq-${i}"]:checked`);
    const given = checked ? checked.value : '(မဖြေရသေး)';
    const correct = checked && checked.value === item.answer;
    if(correct) mcqScore++;
    review.push({section:'MCQ', label:`(${ROMAN[i]})`, q:item.q, given, correctAns:item.answer, correct});
  });
  return {tfScore, fibScore, mcqScore, total: tfScore+fibScore+mcqScore, review};
}
function submitExam(){
  stopTimer();
  const result = gradeExam(currentExamData);
  const existing = myScores[currentSet.id] || {best:0, last:0, attempts:0};
  existing.best = Math.max(existing.best, result.total);
  existing.last = result.total;
  existing.attempts += 1;
  myScores[currentSet.id] = existing;
  renderResult(result, existing);
  showView('result');
}
function renderResult(result, sc){
  const tfN = currentSet.tf.length, fibN = currentSet.fib.length, mcqN = currentSet.mcq.length;
  const totalN = tfN + fibN + mcqN;
  document.getElementById('score-num').textContent = result.total;
  document.getElementById('score-den').textContent = `/ ${totalN}`;
  document.getElementById('tf-score').textContent = `${result.tfScore}/${tfN}`;
  document.getElementById('fib-score').textContent = `${result.fibScore}/${fibN}`;
  document.getElementById('mcq-score').textContent = `${result.mcqScore}/${mcqN}`;
  document.getElementById('best-line').textContent = `This session — best: ${sc.best}/${totalN} · Attempts: ${sc.attempts}`;
  document.getElementById('review-list').innerHTML = result.review.map(r=>`
    <div class="review-item ${r.correct?'correct':'wrong'}">
      <p class="rq"><span class="mono" style="color:var(--ink-soft);font-size:12px">${r.section} ${r.label}</span><br>${formatMath(r.q)}</p>
      <p class="ra">သင့်အဖြေ: <span class="given">${escapeHtml(r.given)}</span>${r.correct?'':`  ·  မှန်ကန်သောအဖြေ: <span class="correctans">${formatMath(r.correctAns)}</span>`}</p>
      ${r.hint ? `<p class="ra" style="color:var(--ink-soft);margin-top:4px;">💡 ${formatMath(r.hint)}</p>` : ''}
    </div>`).join('');
}

// ---------- PROBLEMS SEARCH: "Example 1" / "Exercise 2.3" jumps straight to that problem ----------
function resetProblemsFilter(){
  document.querySelectorAll('#problems-list .problem-item').forEach(el=>{
    el.classList.remove('search-filtered-out','search-hit');
  });
  document.getElementById('problems-search-msg').style.display = 'none';
}
function jumpToProblem(query){
  const msgEl = document.getElementById('problems-search-msg');
  const q = (query || '').trim();
  resetProblemsFilter();
  if(!q) return;
  const items = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#problems-list .problem-item'));

  // 1) "Example 1" / "Exercise 2.3" / "Exercise 3" style — number-based lookup.
  // A single number (no dot) matches EITHER the chapter-relative number ("Example 3")
  // OR the sub-number of any example ("Example 8.3" — since "Exercise 3" should find it too).
  const qNums = (q.match(/(\d+(?:\.\d+)*)/) || [null])[0];
  if(qNums){
    const qSegs = qNums.split('.');
    const numMatches = items.filter(el=>{
      const ref = el.dataset.ref || '';
      const m = ref.match(/(\d+(?:\.\d+)*)/);
      if(!m) return false;
      const refSegs = m[1].split('.');
      const prefixMatch = refSegs.length >= qSegs.length && qSegs.every((seg,i)=> refSegs[i]===seg);
      const lastSegMatch = qSegs.length===1 && refSegs[refSegs.length-1]===qSegs[0];
      return prefixMatch || lastSegMatch;
    });
    if(numMatches.length===1){
      numMatches[0].scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth', block:'start'});
      numMatches[0].classList.add('search-hit');
      setTimeout(()=> numMatches[0].classList.remove('search-hit'), 1800);
      return;
    }
    if(numMatches.length>1){
      items.forEach(el=>{ if(!numMatches.includes(el)) el.classList.add('search-filtered-out'); });
      numMatches[0].scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth', block:'start'});
      numMatches.forEach(el=> el.classList.add('search-hit'));
      setTimeout(()=> numMatches.forEach(el=> el.classList.remove('search-hit')), 1800);
      msgEl.style.color = 'var(--green)';
      msgEl.textContent = `"${escapeHtml(q)}" နဲ့ ကိုက်ညီတဲ့ ပုစ္ဆာ ${numMatches.length} ပုဒ် တွေ့ပါတယ်။`;
      msgEl.style.display = 'block';
      return;
    }
  }

  // 2) keyword search (e.g. "Doppler effect") — filter the list down to problems whose
  // name/question/answer text mentions it, so the person can see every matching problem at once
  const qLower = q.toLowerCase();
  const matches = items.filter(el=>{
    const text = (el.dataset.name||'') + ' ' + el.textContent;
    return text.toLowerCase().includes(qLower);
  });
  if(matches.length){
    items.forEach(el=>{ if(!matches.includes(el)) el.classList.add('search-filtered-out'); });
    matches[0].scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth', block:'start'});
    matches.forEach(el=> el.classList.add('search-hit'));
    setTimeout(()=> matches.forEach(el=> el.classList.remove('search-hit')), 1800);
    msgEl.style.color = 'var(--green)';
    msgEl.textContent = `"${escapeHtml(q)}" နဲ့ ဆိုင်တဲ့ ပုစ္ဆာ ${matches.length} ပုဒ် တွေ့ပါတယ်။`;
    msgEl.style.display = 'block';
  } else {
    msgEl.style.color = 'var(--red)';
    msgEl.textContent = `"${escapeHtml(q)}" နဲ့ ကိုက်ညီတဲ့ ပုစ္ဆာ ဒီ Chapter ထဲမှာ မတွေ့ပါ။`;
    msgEl.style.display = 'block';
  }
}
document.getElementById('problems-search-btn').addEventListener('click', ()=>{
  jumpToProblem(document.getElementById('problems-search-input').value);
});
document.getElementById('problems-search-input').addEventListener('keydown', (e)=>{
  if(e.key === 'Enter'){ e.preventDefault(); jumpToProblem(e.target.value); }
});
document.getElementById('problems-search-input').addEventListener('input', (e)=>{
  if(!e.target.value.trim()) resetProblemsFilter();
});
