});
// ---------- trusted (online) time check ----------
// Reads the hosting server's own HTTP "Date" response header (same-origin, so no CORS issue)
// to detect the real current time, instead of trusting the device's own clock — this stops
// someone from getting past the trial window just by changing their phone/computer's date.
// If the page is opened offline (or as a local file with no server), this silently fails and
// the device clock is used as a fallback, so the app still works without internet.
let trustedTimeOffsetMs = 0; // serverTime - Date.now(); stays 0 (i.e. trust the device) if the check can't run
async function syncTrustedTime(){
  try{
    const controller = new AbortController();
    const timeout = setTimeout(()=> controller.abort(), 2500);
    const resp = await fetch(window.location.href, {method:'HEAD', cache:'no-store', signal:controller.signal});
    clearTimeout(timeout);
    const dateHeader = resp.headers.get('date');
    if(dateHeader){
      const serverTime = new Date(dateHeader).getTime();
      if(!isNaN(serverTime)) trustedTimeOffsetMs = serverTime - Date.now();
    }
  }catch(e){
    // offline, local file://, or the request timed out — fall back to the device clock
  }
}
function trustedNow(){
  return new Date(Date.now() + trustedTimeOffsetMs);
}
function attemptLogin(){
  if(!_dataReady){
    document.getElementById('login-error').textContent = 'App ဒေတာ Load ဆဲ — ခဏစောင့်ပြီး ထပ်ကြိုးစားပါ။';
    document.getElementById('login-error').style.display = 'block';
    return;
  }
  // username field is no longer shown/checked — everyone logs in with just a password,
  // and WHICH password they typed decides whether they're a student, trial user, or admin
  const p = document.getElementById('login-password-input').value.trim();
  const isAdmin = (p === ADMIN_LOGIN_PASSWORD);
  const now = trustedNow();
  if((now < TRIAL_START || now > TRIAL_END) && !isAdmin){
    // outside the trial window — only the admin password may still log in
    document.getElementById('login-error').textContent = 'ဒီ App ရဲ့ အသုံးပြုခွင့်ကာလ ကုန်ဆုံးသွားပါပြီ။ ဆရာ/ဆရာမကို ဆက်သွယ်ပါ။';
    document.getElementById('login-error').style.display = 'block';
    return;
  }
  if(p === LOGIN_PASSWORD){
    isTrialUser = false;
    isAdminUser = false;
  } else if(p === TRIAL_USER_PASSWORD){
    isTrialUser = false; // trial account currently granted full access too
    isAdminUser = false;
  } else if(isAdmin){
    isTrialUser = false; // admin account — full access, not restricted by TRIAL_START/TRIAL_END
    isAdminUser = true;
  } else {
    document.getElementById('login-error').textContent = 'Password မှားနေပါသည်။';
    document.getElementById('login-error').style.display = 'block';
    return;
  }
  document.getElementById('login-error').style.display = 'none';
  renderHome();
}
document.getElementById('login-form').addEventListener('submit', (e)=>{ e.preventDefault(); attemptLogin(); });
document.getElementById('logout-btn').addEventListener('click', async ()=>{
  const ok = await showConfirm('Logout ထွက်မှာ သေချာပါသလား?');
  if(!ok) return;
  stopTimer();
  isTrialUser = false;
  isAdminUser = false;
  document.getElementById('login-username-input').value = '';
  document.getElementById('login-password-input').value = '';
  document.getElementById('login-error').style.display = 'none';
  showView('login');
});

// ---------- scientific calculator (Problems tab) ----------
(function(){
  let expr = ''; // what's shown/typed on the input line, using display symbols
  let cursorPos = 0; // caret index within expr
  let engMode = false; // false = standard, true = engineering notation
  let angleMode = 'D'; // 'D' = degrees, 'R' = radians — affects sin/cos/tan
  let lastValue = null; // last computed numeric value (for ENG re-format)
  let lastAnswer = null; // last "=" result, recalled by the Ans button
  let shiftArmed = false; // true right after SHIFT is tapped; applies to the next key only
  let fracDisplayOn = false; // S⇄D: show the result as a fraction instead of a decimal
  const history = []; // {expr, result} pairs, oldest first
  let historyIndex = 0; // points past the end while "live"; walks back on ↑
  let draftExpr = ''; // saved live expr while browsing history

  const inputEl = document.getElementById('calc-input');
  const resultEl = document.getElementById('calc-result');
  const errorEl = document.getElementById('calc-error');
  const engBtn = document.getElementById('calc-eng-btn');
  const modeBtn = document.getElementById('calc-mode-btn');
  const shiftBtn = document.getElementById('calc-shift-btn');
  const sdBtn = document.getElementById('calc-sd-btn');

  // continued-fraction approximation of a decimal, e.g. 0.75 -> {num:3, den:4}
  function decimalToFraction(x){
    if(!isFinite(x)) return null;
    const sign = x < 0 ? -1 : 1;
    x = Math.abs(x);
    const tolerance = 1e-9;
    let h1 = 1, h2 = 0, k1 = 0, k2 = 1, b = x;
    let iterations = 0;
    while(iterations < 30){
      const a = Math.floor(b);
      const newH = a * h1 + h2;
      const newK = a * k1 + k2;
      h2 = h1; h1 = newH;
      k2 = k1; k1 = newK;
      if(k1 > 1e6 || Math.abs(x - h1 / k1) < x * tolerance) break;
      b = 1 / (b - a);
      iterations++;
    }
    return { num: sign * h1, den: k1 };
  }

  // trig helpers respect the current D/R mode; exposed on window so the sandboxed
  // Function() below (which only sees global scope) can call them, while still
  // closing over this IIFE's angleMode variable.
  function __calcSin(x){ return Math.sin(angleMode === 'D' ? x * Math.PI / 180 : x); }
  function __calcCos(x){ return Math.cos(angleMode === 'D' ? x * Math.PI / 180 : x); }
  function __calcTan(x){ return Math.tan(angleMode === 'D' ? x * Math.PI / 180 : x); }
  window.__calcSin = __calcSin;
  window.__calcCos = __calcCos;
  window.__calcTan = __calcTan;

  function toEvalString(s, allowVar){
    // convert display expression into a safe JS-evaluable expression
    let out = s
      .replace(/×/g, '*')
      .replace(/÷/g, '/')
      .replace(/π/g, '(3.141592653589793)')
      .replace(/√\(/g, 'Math.sqrt(')
      .replace(/∛\(/g, 'Math.cbrt(')
      .replace(/sin\(/g, '__calcSin(')
      .replace(/cos\(/g, '__calcCos(')
      .replace(/tan\(/g, '__calcTan(')
      .replace(/ln\(/g, 'Math.log(')
      .replace(/log\(/g, 'Math.log10(')
      .replace(/\^/g, '**');
    // whitelist check: only digits, operators, parens, dot, spaces, and the safe function tokens we inserted
    // (allowVar also permits the letter "x" — used only for building an f(x) for the ∫dx integral)
    const stripped = out.replace(/Math\.sqrt|Math\.cbrt|Math\.log10|Math\.log|__calcSin|__calcCos|__calcTan/g, '');
    const badCharsPattern = allowVar ? /[^0-9+\-*/().%\sx]/ : /[^0-9+\-*/().%\s]/;
    if(badCharsPattern.test(stripped)){
      throw new Error('invalid');
    }
    return out;
  }

  // escape + turn "^2" / "^(-1)" style exponents into <sup> for on-screen display only
  function toSupHtml(s){
    return (s || '')
      .replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
      .replace(/\^\(([^()]*)\)/g, '<sup>$1</sup>')
      .replace(/\^(-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?)/g, '<sup>$1</sup>');
  }

  // find every top-level "(num)/(den)" fraction template in the expression,
  // with the character positions of its numerator/denominator, so it can be
  // rendered as a real stacked fraction (like a Casio fx-991ES natural display)
  function findFracRegions(s){
    const re = /\(([^()]*)\)\/\(([^()]*)\)/g;
    const regions = [];
    let m;
    while((m = re.exec(s))){
      const numStart = m.index + 1;
      const numEnd = numStart + m[1].length;
      const denStart = numEnd + 3; // skips ')' '/' '('
      const denEnd = denStart + m[2].length;
      regions.push({ start: m.index, end: m.index + m[0].length, num: m[1], den: m[2], numStart, numEnd, denStart, denEnd });
    }
    return regions;
  }

  // which fraction (if any) the cursor currently sits inside, and whether it's in the numerator or denominator
  function findActiveFrac(pos){
    const regions = findFracRegions(expr);
    for(const r of regions){
      if(pos >= r.numStart && pos <= r.numEnd) return { region: r, part: 'num' };
      if(pos > r.numEnd && pos < r.denStart) return { region: r, part: 'num' }; // the ")/(" gap — snap to numerator
      if(pos >= r.denStart && pos <= r.denEnd) return { region: r, part: 'den' };
    }
    return null;
  }

  function plainSegHtml(text, offset, cursor){
    if(cursor === null || cursor < offset || cursor > offset + text.length) return toSupHtml(text);
    const lc = cursor - offset;
    return toSupHtml(text.slice(0, lc)) + '<span class="calc-cursor"></span>' + toSupHtml(text.slice(lc));
  }

  function fracSegHtml(r, cursor){
    let numHtml = toSupHtml(r.num) || '&nbsp;';
    let denHtml = toSupHtml(r.den) || '&nbsp;';
    if(cursor !== null){
      if(cursor >= r.numStart && cursor <= r.numEnd){
        const lc = cursor - r.numStart;
        numHtml = toSupHtml(r.num.slice(0, lc)) + '<span class="calc-cursor"></span>' + toSupHtml(r.num.slice(lc));
      } else if(cursor > r.numEnd && cursor < r.denStart){
        numHtml = (toSupHtml(r.num) || '') + '<span class="calc-cursor"></span>';
      } else if(cursor >= r.denStart && cursor <= r.denEnd){
        const lc = cursor - r.denStart;
        denHtml = toSupHtml(r.den.slice(0, lc)) + '<span class="calc-cursor"></span>' + toSupHtml(r.den.slice(lc));
      }
    }
    return '<span class="calc-frac"><span class="cf-num">' + numHtml + '</span><span class="cf-bar"></span><span class="cf-den">' + denHtml + '</span></span>';
  }

  // builds the display HTML for `text`; pass cursor=null for a finalized (no caret) render
  function buildDisplayHtml(text, cursor){
    const regions = findFracRegions(text);
    if(!regions.length) return plainSegHtml(text, 0, cursor);
    let html = '';
    let last = 0;
    regions.forEach(r=>{
      html += plainSegHtml(text.slice(last, r.start), last, cursor);
      html += fracSegHtml(r, cursor);
      last = r.end;
    });
    html += plainSegHtml(text.slice(last), last, cursor);
    return html;
  }

  function renderInputLive(){
    if(!expr){ inputEl.innerHTML = '&nbsp;'; return; }
    inputEl.innerHTML = buildDisplayHtml(expr, cursorPos);
  }

  // engineering notation shown as "mantissa×10^exp" — toSupHtml renders the "^exp" part
  // as a real superscript power of ten, matching how a Casio shows it (never an "E" form)
  function toEngineering(val){
    if(val === 0) return '0';
    const sign = val < 0 ? '-' : '';
    const v = Math.abs(val);
    const exp = Math.floor(Math.log10(v));
    let engExp = Math.floor(exp / 3) * 3;
    let mantissa = v / Math.pow(10, engExp);
    mantissa = Math.round(mantissa * 1e6) / 1e6;
    if(mantissa >= 1000){ mantissa /= 1000; engExp += 3; }
    if(engExp === 0) return sign + mantissa;
    return sign + mantissa + '×10^' + engExp;
  }

  function formatResult(val){
    if(typeof val !== 'number' || !isFinite(val)) return '—';
    const rounded = Math.round(val * 1e10) / 1e10;
    return engMode ? toEngineering(rounded) : String(rounded);
  }

  function renderResult(){
    if(fracDisplayOn && typeof lastValue === 'number' && isFinite(lastValue)){
      const f = decimalToFraction(lastValue);
      if(f && f.den !== 1){
        const sign = f.num < 0 ? '-' : '';
        resultEl.innerHTML = sign + '<span class="calc-frac"><span class="cf-num">' + Math.abs(f.num) + '</span><span class="cf-bar"></span><span class="cf-den">' + f.den + '</span></span>';
        return;
      }
    }
    resultEl.innerHTML = toSupHtml(formatResult(lastValue));
  }

  function insertAtCursor(str){
    expr = expr.slice(0, cursorPos) + str + expr.slice(cursorPos);
    cursorPos += str.length;
  }

  function liveEvaluate(){
    renderInputLive();
    errorEl.style.display = 'none';
    if(!expr.trim()){ lastValue = null; resultEl.textContent = '0'; return; }
    try{
      const jsExpr = toEvalString(expr);
      // eslint-disable-next-line no-new-func
      const val = Function('"use strict"; return (' + jsExpr + ')')();
      if(typeof val === 'number' && isFinite(val)){
        lastValue = val;
        renderResult();
      } else {
        resultEl.textContent = '—';
      }
    } catch(e){
      // leave last valid result showing while mid-typing; only flag invalid on '='
    }
  }

  function pressEquals(){
    if(!expr.trim()) return;
    try{
      const jsExpr = toEvalString(expr);
      const val = Function('"use strict"; return (' + jsExpr + ')')();
      if(typeof val !== 'number' || !isFinite(val)) throw new Error('bad');
      inputEl.innerHTML = buildDisplayHtml(expr, null);
      lastValue = val;
      renderResult();
      history.push({ expr: expr, result: formatResult(val) });
      historyIndex = history.length;
      draftExpr = '';
      lastAnswer = Math.round(val * 1e10) / 1e10;
      expr = String(lastAnswer);
      cursorPos = expr.length;
      errorEl.style.display = 'none';
    } catch(e){
      errorEl.textContent = 'ပြန်စစ်ပါ — ဂ်နန်း အမှားပါ။';
      errorEl.style.display = 'block';
    }
  }

  function buildFnFromExpr(fExpr){
    if(!fExpr.trim()) throw new Error('empty');
    const jsExpr = toEvalString(fExpr, true);
    return new Function('x', '"use strict"; return (' + jsExpr + ')');
  }

  function simpsonIntegrate(fn, a, b, n){
    if(n % 2 !== 0) n++;
    if(n < 2) n = 2;
    const h = (b - a) / n;
    let sum = fn(a) + fn(b);
    for(let i = 1; i < n; i++){
      const xi = a + i * h;
      const yi = fn(xi);
      if(!isFinite(yi)) throw new Error('bad');
      sum += (i % 2 === 0 ? 2 : 4) * yi;
    }
    return (h / 3) * sum;
  }

  function closeIntegralPrompt(){
    const ov = document.getElementById('calc-int-overlay');
    if(ov) ov.style.display = 'none';
  }

  function openIntegralPrompt(){
    const ov = document.getElementById('calc-int-overlay');
    const aInput = document.getElementById('calc-int-a');
    const bInput = document.getElementById('calc-int-b');
    if(!ov) return;
    aInput.value = '';
    bInput.value = '';
    ov.style.display = 'flex';
    aInput.focus();
  }

  function computeIntegral(){
    const aInput = document.getElementById('calc-int-a');
    const bInput = document.getElementById('calc-int-b');
    const a = parseFloat(aInput.value);
    const b = parseFloat(bInput.value);
    if(!isFinite(a) || !isFinite(b)){
      errorEl.textContent = 'အထက်/အောက် နယ်နိမိတ် ကိန်းများ မှန်ကန်စွာ ထည့်ပါ။';
      errorEl.style.display = 'block';
      return;
    }
    try{
      const fn = buildFnFromExpr(expr);
      const val = simpsonIntegrate(fn, a, b, 200);
      if(typeof val !== 'number' || !isFinite(val)) throw new Error('bad');
      const label = '∫(' + expr + ')dx, x:' + a + '→' + b;
      inputEl.innerHTML = buildDisplayHtml(label, null);
      lastValue = val;
      renderResult();
      history.push({ expr: label, result: formatResult(val) });
      historyIndex = history.length;
      draftExpr = '';
      lastAnswer = Math.round(val * 1e10) / 1e10;
      expr = String(lastAnswer);
      cursorPos = expr.length;
      errorEl.style.display = 'none';
      closeIntegralPrompt();
    } catch(e){
      errorEl.textContent = 'ပြန်စစ်ပါ — f(x) ပုံသေနည်း အမှားပါ။';
      errorEl.style.display = 'block';
      closeIntegralPrompt();
    }
  }

  function goHistory(dir){
    if(!history.length) return;
    if(dir === 'up'){
      if(historyIndex === history.length) draftExpr = expr; // leaving live draft, remember it
      if(historyIndex > 0) historyIndex--;
    } else {
      if(historyIndex < history.length) historyIndex++;
    }
    expr = (historyIndex === history.length) ? draftExpr : history[historyIndex].expr;
    cursorPos = expr.length;
    liveEvaluate();
  }

  function handleCalcBtn(key, btn){
    switch(key){
      case 'clear':
        expr = ''; cursorPos = 0;
        errorEl.style.display = 'none';
        liveEvaluate();
        return;
      case 'backspace':
        if(cursorPos > 0){
          expr = expr.slice(0, cursorPos - 1) + expr.slice(cursorPos);
          cursorPos--;
        }
        liveEvaluate();
        return;
      case '=':
        pressEquals();
        return;
      case 'left':
        cursorPos = Math.max(0, cursorPos - 1);
        renderInputLive();
        return;
      case 'right':
        cursorPos = Math.min(expr.length, cursorPos + 1);
        renderInputLive();
        return;
      case 'up': {
        const active = findActiveFrac(cursorPos);
        if(active && active.part === 'den'){
          cursorPos = active.region.numStart;
          renderInputLive();
          return;
        }
        goHistory('up');
        return;
      }
      case 'down': {
        const active = findActiveFrac(cursorPos);
        if(active && active.part === 'num'){
          cursorPos = active.region.denStart;
          renderInputLive();
          return;
        }
        goHistory('down');
        return;
      }
      case 'eng':
        engMode = !engMode;
        if(engBtn) engBtn.classList.toggle('calc-eng-on', engMode);
        renderResult();
        return;
      case 'mode':
        openAngleModeChooser();
        return;
      case 'shift':
        shiftArmed = !shiftArmed;
        if(shiftBtn) shiftBtn.classList.toggle('calc-shift-on', shiftArmed);
        return;
      case 'sd':
        fracDisplayOn = !fracDisplayOn;
        if(sdBtn) sdBtn.classList.toggle('calc-eng-on', fracDisplayOn);
        renderResult();
        return;
      case 'sin':
        insertAtCursor('sin(');
        break;
      case 'cos':
        insertAtCursor('cos(');
        break;
      case 'tan':
        insertAtCursor('tan(');
        break;
      case 'ln':
        insertAtCursor('ln(');
        break;
      case 'log':
        insertAtCursor('log(');
        break;
      case 'frac':
        insertAtCursor('()/()');
        cursorPos -= 4; // land cursor inside the first parentheses
        break;
      case 'x2':
        insertAtCursor('^2');
        break;
      case 'xy':
        insertAtCursor('^');
        break;
      case 'sqrt':
        insertAtCursor(shiftArmed ? '∛(' : '√(');
        break;
      case 'pi':
        insertAtCursor('π');
        break;
      case 'exp':
        insertAtCursor(shiftArmed ? 'π' : '×10^(');
        break;
      case 'ans':
        if(lastAnswer !== null) insertAtCursor(String(lastAnswer));
        break;
      case 'percent':
        insertAtCursor('/100');
        break;
      case 'x':
        insertAtCursor('x');
        break;
      case 'inv':
        insertAtCursor('^(-1)');
        break;
      case 'mod':
        insertAtCursor('%');
        break;
      case 'calc':
        pressEquals();
        return;
      case 'integral':
        openIntegralPrompt();
        return;
      case 'sign':
        expr = expr ? '(-1)*(' + expr + ')' : expr;
        cursorPos = expr.length;
        break;
      default:
        insertAtCursor(key);
    }
    if(shiftArmed){
      shiftArmed = false;
      if(shiftBtn) shiftBtn.classList.remove('calc-shift-on');
    }
    liveEvaluate();
  }

  // "Mode" opens a chooser (like a real Casio's MODE key) instead of silently toggling
  function openAngleModeChooser(){
    const overlay = document.getElementById('modal-overlay');
    document.getElementById('modal-message').textContent = 'Angle Mode ရွေးပါ — D = Degree, R = Radian';
    const actions = document.getElementById('modal-actions');
    actions.innerHTML = '';
    const dBtn = document.createElement('button');
    dBtn.type = 'button'; dBtn.className = (angleMode === 'D') ? 'danger' : 'ghost'; dBtn.textContent = 'D (Degree)';
    const rBtn = document.createElement('button');
    rBtn.type = 'button'; rBtn.className = (angleMode === 'R') ? 'danger' : 'ghost'; rBtn.textContent = 'R (Radian)';
    actions.appendChild(dBtn); actions.appendChild(rBtn);
    const close = (choice)=>{
      overlay.classList.add('hidden');
      if(choice){
        angleMode = choice;
        if(modeBtn) modeBtn.classList.toggle('calc-mode-r', angleMode === 'R');
        liveEvaluate();
      }
    };
    dBtn.addEventListener('click', ()=> close('D'));
    rBtn.addEventListener('click', ()=> close('R'));
    overlay.classList.remove('hidden');
  }

  document.querySelectorAll('.calc-btn').forEach(btn=>{
    btn.addEventListener('click', ()=> handleCalcBtn(btn.dataset.calc, btn));
    const pressOn = ()=> btn.classList.add('calc-btn-press');
    const pressOff = ()=> btn.classList.remove('calc-btn-press');
    btn.addEventListener('pointerdown', pressOn);
    btn.addEventListener('pointerup', pressOff);
    btn.addEventListener('pointerleave', pressOff);
    btn.addEventListener('pointercancel', pressOff);
  });

  document.getElementById('calc-int-cancel').addEventListener('click', closeIntegralPrompt);
  document.getElementById('calc-int-go').addEventListener('click', computeIntegral);

  document.getElementById('calc-fab').addEventListener('click', ()=>{
    document.getElementById('calc-overlay').classList.remove('hidden');
  });
  document.getElementById('calc-close-btn').addEventListener('click', ()=>{
    document.getElementById('calc-overlay').classList.add('hidden');
  });
  document.getElementById('calc-overlay').addEventListener('click', (e)=>{
    if(e.target.id === 'calc-overlay') document.getElementById('calc-overlay').classList.add('hidden');
  });
})();

document.getElementById('start-exam-btn').addEventListener('click', ()=>{
  const minutes = Math.max(1, Number(document.getElementById('intro-timer-input').value) || currentSet.timerMinutes);
  startExam(currentSet, minutes);
});
async function handleExitExam(){
  const ok = await showConfirm('ဖြေဆိုနေတာ ရပ်ပြီး ထွက်မည်လား? ရမှတ် မမှတ်ပါဘူး၊ ဒီ Set ကို နောက်မှ ပြန်စဖြေနိုင်ပါတယ်။');
  if(!ok) return;
  stopTimer();
  renderCurrentSetList();
  showView('chapter');
}
document.getElementById('exit-exam-btn').addEventListener('click', handleExitExam);
document.getElementById('exit-exam-btn-top').addEventListener('click', handleExitExam);

// floating "scroll to top / bottom" buttons — shown on every tab (except the login/trial-gate screens)
// so a long page (40-question exam, long notes list, etc.) can be jumped through without manual scrolling
const NO_SCROLL_BTN_VIEWS = ['trial-gate','login'];
const SCROLL_VIEW_NAMES = ['home','browse','chapter','notes','formula','units','definitions','problems','shortq','drawing','examIntro','exam','result'];
function updateScrollButtons(){
  const topBtn = document.getElementById('scroll-top-btn');
  const bottomBtn = document.getElementById('scroll-bottom-btn');
  const hidden = NO_SCROLL_BTN_VIEWS.some(v=> !document.getElementById(v+'-view').classList.contains('hidden'));
  topBtn.classList.toggle('show', !hidden);
  bottomBtn.classList.toggle('show', !hidden);
}
function activeViewEl(){
  const name = SCROLL_VIEW_NAMES.find(v=> !document.getElementById(v+'-view').classList.contains('hidden'));
  return name ? document.getElementById(name+'-view') : null;
}
(function(){
  const topBtn = document.getElementById('scroll-top-btn');
  const bottomBtn = document.getElementById('scroll-bottom-btn');
  topBtn.addEventListener('click', (e)=>{
    e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation();
    window.scrollTo({top:0, left:0, behavior:'smooth'});
  });
  bottomBtn.addEventListener('click', (e)=>{
    e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation();
    // land on the Submit/Exit footer of the CURRENT screen only — never on document.body.scrollHeight,
    // which can land past the footer and put the fixed circle right on top of the real Submit button
    const view = activeViewEl();
    const footer = view ? view.querySelector('.footer-actions') : null;
    if(footer){
      footer.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth', block:'end'});
    } else {
      window.scrollTo({top:document.body.scrollHeight, left:0, behavior:'smooth'});
    }
  });
})();
document.getElementById('submit-exam-btn').addEventListener('click', async ()=>{
  const ok = await showConfirm('ဖြေဆိုပြီးပြီလား? တင်သွင်းပြီးရင် အဖြေပြောင်းလို့ မရတော့ပါ။');
  if(!ok) return;
  submitExam();
});
document.getElementById('retake-btn').addEventListener('click', ()=> startExam(currentSet, currentSet.timerMinutes));
document.getElementById('back-to-chapter-btn').addEventListener('click', ()=>{ renderCurrentSetList(); showView('chapter'); });
document.getElementById('home-from-result-btn').addEventListener('click', ()=> renderHome());

(async function initTrialGate(){
  await syncTrustedTime();
  const now = trustedNow();
  if(now < TRIAL_START){
    document.getElementById('trial-gate-tag').textContent = 'COMING SOON';
    document.getElementById('trial-gate-title').textContent = 'မစတင်ရသေးပါ';
    document.getElementById('trial-gate-message').textContent =
      `ဒီ App ကို ${TRIAL_START.toLocaleDateString('en-GB',{day:'numeric',month:'long',year:'numeric'})} ကနေစပြီး အသုံးပြုနိုင်ပါမည်။ ကျေးဇူးပြု၍ အဲ့နေ့ရောက်မှ ပြန်ဖွင့်ပါ။`;
    showView('trial-gate');
    return;
  }
  if(now > TRIAL_END){
    document.getElementById('trial-gate-tag').textContent = 'EXPIRED';
    document.getElementById('trial-gate-title').textContent = 'အစမ်းသုံးကာလ ကုန်ဆုံးသွားပါပြီ';
    document.getElementById('trial-gate-message').textContent =
      `ဒီ App ရဲ့ အစမ်းသုံးကာလသည် ${TRIAL_END.toLocaleDateString('en-GB',{day:'numeric',month:'long',year:'numeric'})} တွင် ကုန်ဆုံးသွားပါပြီ။ ဆက်လက်အသုံးပြုလိုပါက ဆရာ/ဆရာမကို ဆက်သွယ်ပါ။`;
    showView('login'); // still routes to the login form — the admin account can log in past TRIAL_END even though students/trial cannot
    return;
  }
  showView('login');
})();
